text: The bathroom floor was dirty and the towels smelled damp.
Check-in took too long and our room was not ready on arrival.
Breakfast was excellent and the restaurant team was very helpful.
Loud music from the event hall kept us awake past midnight.
The room air conditioning was broken and hot water was unreliable.
The staff were friendly and made the stay wonderful.
Room service was slow and nobody followed up on our request.
The pool area and gym were closed without any notice.
